algorithm: one-sided Jacobi SVD of RMS-normalized n-by-3 Z; B=Z,V=I; rotate columns of B and V directly, never form/invert Gram matrix
arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 round-to-nearest; no fast-math; all matrix sums in ascending row order; standalone C++17
convergence: All three |dot(Bp,Bq)| <= 8*epsilon*norm(Bp)*norm(Bq); recompute after each complete sweep. Zero column is orthogonal. Eight eps accounts for binary64 rotations and dot-product rounding, target many orders below canonical 1e-9 orthogonality gate. No data-dependent tolerance changes.

equivalence.eligibility: exact for every fixture including canonical rejections
equivalence.residual_RMS: abs difference <= 1e-9*max(canonical_RMS,1e-10); stricter than normalized-output tolerance

residual: RD=D-Z*beta using ascending columns; RMS=sqrt(sum(RD^2)/n); normalized=RD/RMS; never clip or reproject
rotation: tau=(b-a)/(2*g); t=copysign(1,tau)/(abs(tau)+hypot(1,tau)); c=1/hypot(1,t), s=c*t; Bp=c*Bp-s*Bq; Bq=s*Bp+c*Bq; same for V. If |tau| overflows use t=g/(b-a).
sign: largest absolute B column component, first row on tie, positive; flip B and corresponding V together
singular_values: Euclidean norms of B columns; U=B/sigma
sorting: descending singular value; stable original index for ties
